paper.title_en: Black-Hole First Laws and Horizon Constraints: A Differential Rank Criterion
paper.abstract_en: Thermodynamic rewritings of horizon equations depend on which relations are varied and which have already been imposed. We formulate a differential rank criterion that makes these choices explicit. The construction uses a stationary metric family together with an independently marked radial surface, physical charges determined by the metric parameters, and specified extensions of the horizon thermodynamic quantities. A first-law covector is pointwise representable by selected constraints precisely when it lies in the span of their differentials. We distinguish this algebraic condition from a smooth identity in a neighborhood. If regular constraints already define the complete physical family, pointwise representability follows from the first law itself; a neighborhood identity additionally depends on the chosen extensions. With explicit prescriptions, Kerr--Newman, rotating BTZ black holes in new massive gravity, and the new-type NMG black hole all exhibit exact alignment with their horizon constraints. By contrast, substituting an exact metric family into a field-equation component can annihilate that residual before any horizon condition is tested. We also give an explicit entropy--volume comparison and specify the role of fixed ensemble data in free-energy variations. The framework separates consequences of the established first law from additional claims about selected constraints and their extensions.

decision.selection_reason_zh: 该文以微分秩准则形式化黑洞视界热力学第一定律的改写条件，明确区分点态可表示性与邻域恒等式，并给出Kerr-Newman、旋转BTZ及NMGBH等具体例证，对第一定律的适用范围与额外约束的作用有细致辨析，理论深度较高，适合黑洞热力学方向的研究者深入阅读。
decision.title_zh: 黑洞第一定律与视界约束：一个微分秩准则
decision.abstract_zh: 视界方程的热力学改写取决于哪些关系被变分以及哪些关系已被施加。我们提出一个微分秩准则，使这些选择显式化。该构造使用一个稳态度规族以及一个独立标记的径向曲面、由度规参数确定的物理荷，以及视界热力学量的指定延拓。一个第一定律余向量当且仅当位于所选约束的微分张成的空间内时，才可逐点由这些约束表示。我们将这一代数条件与邻域中的光滑恒等式区分开来。如果正则约束已经定义了完整的物理族，则逐点可表示性由第一定律本身推出；而邻域恒等式还额外依赖于所选的延拓。在显式给定的规定下，Kerr-Newman、新质量引力中的旋转BTZ黑洞以及新型NMG黑洞都表现出与其视界约束的精确吻合。相比之下，将一个精确的度规族代入场方程的一个分量，可能在检验任何视界条件之前就消去该残余项。我们还给出一个显式的熵-体积比较，并明确固定系综数据在自由能变分中的作用。该框架将已确立的第一定律的推论与关于所选约束及其延拓的额外论断分离开来。
